mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate crosses above 6% for the first time in 3 months, signaling a recessionary labor market, S&P 500 forward returns turn negative within the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE crosses above 6% but 20-day returns remain non-negative, or if returns turn positive despite the rate crossing.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (chained 2017 dollars) and HOUST (units) indicates strengthening demand across sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If returns do not correlate with both GDPC1 and HOUST rising simultaneously over the 5-day horizon, or if the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3% over 3 months reduces growth expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: During a tightening cycle, if FEDFUNDS rises but returns remain positive, or if the effect is not significant (p > 0.05) over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO (supply index) above 92.98 over 3 months reflects robust production growth, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO's upward trend does not lead to higher returns than a baseline (e.g., 5% lower than average in similar periods), or if the relationship is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 exceeds 13,450 chained 2017 dollars for the first time in 3 months, signaling stronger economic activity, S&P 500 forward returns turn positive within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 crosses above 13,450 but returns remain non-positive, or if the effect is not significant (p > 0.05) over 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in PAYEMS (employment) and decrease in UNRATE (unemployment) indicates improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If returns do not rise when both PAYEMS and UNRATE move in tandem, or if the correlation is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained drop in GDPC1 below 13,400 chained 2017 dollars over 3 months signals weakening demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If in late-cycle expansions, GDPC1 drops but returns remain positive, or if the effect is not significant (p > 0.05) over 20 days.
